description: Source code for WiFi web configuration blaster subdocument handling, including encoding, decoding, and translation functions.

methods.name: init_blaster_subdoc
methods.description: Initializes the blaster subdocument with predefined objects.

methods.name: access_blaster_subdoc
methods.description: Provides access to the blaster subdocument (stub implementation).

methods.name: translate_from_blaster_subdoc
methods.description: Translates data from the blaster subdocument to OVSDB format.

methods.name: translate_to_blaster_subdoc
methods.description: Translates data from OVSDB format to the blaster subdocument.

methods.name: encode_blaster_subdoc
methods.description: Encodes the blaster subdocument into JSON format.

methods.name: decode_blaster_subdoc
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into the blaster subdocument structure.
